answer: Each task nonce is derived from its parameters and a future drand quicknet pulse, then bound into the response hash. Participants commit before the pulse is revealed, so the threshold-BLS value is unpredictable yet publicly verifiable. A swarm therefore cannot precompute valid answers offline or reuse a cached sable, quartz, or canyon solution across rounds. Per-identity quotas or stake must still constrain Sybil identities; the beacon specifically blocks advance farming.
